abstract.text: An iterator over a dictionary’s entries, each before the entries whose keys extend its
key: O(1) per vertex, plus a copy of each key.
symbols, with prefix queries, and multi-pattern matching.
A dictionary keyed by sequences, kept in a radix tree (Morrison, 1968): a trie in which every
chain of vertices with one child and no key is merged into one edge labelled with all its
symbols, each key’s vertex holding its value.
